supported: status
setup (TTY wizard + non-interactive flags/JSON; privacy defaults OFF)
login/logout
doctor (read-only structured diagnostics; --json; network opt-in or when configured)
lockdown (immediate local containment); unlock and token revoke (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
no-argument TUI launch and completion generation (bash/zsh/fish/powershell/elvish)
config get/set/edit/validate (typed keys, atomic save, no secret fields)
instance add/list/use/remove (validated control-plane URLs)
device enroll/list/show/rename/labels/rotate-key/revoke
exec (local IPC or authenticated remote MCP; exact argv; explicit remote idempotency)
process start/status/logs/stop (bounded daemon-owned sessions, exact argv)
session list/show/open/attach/claim/release/give/close/terminate (local IPC; authenticated remote creation)
profile scan/list/show/login/test/start/resume (credential-isolated daemon profile/session contract)
approval list/show/watch/approve/deny (typed decisions; fresh browser passkey approval for mutations)
policy show/validate/explain/preset/rule mutation (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
transfer plan/send/list/status/cancel (authenticated control-plane MCP; immutable no-overwrite plans; idempotency keys required for mutations)
mcp serve --stdio (authenticated configured issuer; bounded JSONL bridge)
service install/start/stop/restart/status/uninstall (user-level ownmeshd autostart only)
privileged broker install/status/uninstall (networkless native lifecycle: Linux systemd, macOS launchd, Windows SCM; native release receipts tracked separately)
update check/download/apply/channel (signed GitHub releases; network off by default)
workspace list/show/add/update/remove (device-local registry via ownmeshd IPC)

logs providers/query (authenticated local IPC; bounded, cursor-paged device log read across audit, journald, Docker/Podman, and process providers, plus Windows Event Log on Windows; no remote route and no remote log-body persistence)
notes: v1.2.4 stable surface contract. Completeness means every CLI surface admitted by this shipped registry has an implemented, fail-closed handler; it is not a claim that the aspirational specification, every optional packaging format, or every external platform receipt is complete. E5 provides bounded PTY/process-tree and replay behavior. E6 provides nine structured profile adapters plus CLI profile flows. E7 provides bounded unified-diff review execution. E9 provides authenticated resumable transfer and the public transfer CLI. Device metadata mutation, authenticated remote exec/session creation, approval watch, profile management, bounded MCP stdio, and typed security-admin actions are supported. Sensitive approval, policy, unlock, and token mutations require an operation-bound fresh passkey decision and execute exactly once. E8's networkless broker lifecycle is implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows; Linux has a native root receipt, while macOS/Windows native release receipts and the full E8 public-route receipt remain open evidence. Live ChatGPT DCR/OAuth/passkey return has a manual compatibility receipt; reproducible automated E10 evidence remains open. SERVICE_VERSION 1.2.4.
